exercises.question: Which sentence restates the first idea in other words?
options: El café pagó el ferrocarril; sin embargo, el dinero del café hizo posible el tren.
El café pagó el ferrocarril; es decir, el dinero del café hizo posible el tren.
El café pagó el ferrocarril; además, el dinero del café hizo posible el tren.

exercises.sentence: La ciudad ____ se instaló la corte portuguesa en 1808 era Río de Janeiro.
exercises.english: The city where the Portuguese court settled in 1808 was Rio de Janeiro.

exercises.question: Which sentence says "The Modern Art Week was held in 1922"?
options: En 1922 se celebró la Semana de Arte Moderna.
En 1922 se celebraron la Semana de Arte Moderna.
En 1922 celebró la Semana de Arte Moderna.

exercises.sentence: La bossa nova no nació en una favela; en ____, nació en apartamentos de la zona sur.
exercises.english: Bossa nova was not born in a favela; in fact, it was born in apartments in the south zone.

exercises.question: Which sentence says "The less you read, the less you understand"?

exercises.sentence: Los obreros pararon las fábricas; o ____, hicieron huelga.
exercises.english: The workers stopped the factories; I mean, they went on strike.

exercises.question: According to the texts, in which year did Brasília become the capital of Brazil instead of Rio de Janeiro?
